newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian 714-day bond priced at 98.24 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russian 714-day bond priced at 98.24 pct.

text.p: The average price on an additional tranche of OFZ interest-bearing bonds was 98.24 percent at an auction on Wednesday, the Central Bank said.
Dealers had forecast the price would be in the 98.14-98.37 percent range.
The original bond closed on Tuesday at 98.20 to yield 36.64 percent.
Full details of the auction follow:
In money terms the coupon rate is 162,155 roubles less accurals of 12,473.46 roubles.
On May 14 the Finance Ministry raised 5.18 trillion roubles at an auction of 182-day GKO discount Treasury bills, taking total proceeds from Wednesday's auctions to 7.30 trillion roubles.
It has also repaid about 7.18 trillion roubles in a maturing issue of 224-day T-bills (series 23052).
